channel.description: Updates for ur.transcribe. Generated by scripts/release.sh; newest first.

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
What's new

  • Transcription stops by itself. Zoom calls end when Zoom leaves the meeting, even if it keeps your microphone open afterward. Other apps end when they release the microphone, and any call ends after 5 minutes without speech (change or turn off in Settings).
  • A notification when it starts, with Don't transcribe this call to stop and delete what was captured, and Show transcript.
  • A 20 second countdown before it stops, in a notification and in the menu, with Keep transcribing if the call isn't over.
  • A notification when the transcript is saved, with Show in Finder.
  • Setup now asks for notification permission, and Settings has a section for starting and stopping.

Fixes

  • Call detection no longer pauses while a dialog is open.

Install

If you have 0.1.2, this update installs from inside the app: use Check for Updates… in the menu, or wait for the daily check.

Otherwise, download ur.transcribe-0.1.3-macos-arm64.dmg below, open it, and drag ur.transcribe into Applications.

Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon.

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
What's new

  • ur.transcribe now updates itself. It checks for new versions once a day, and you can use Check for Updates… in the menu or in Settings. When an update arrives, the menu shows it instead of interrupting you, and it never restarts in the middle of a call.
  • Updates are signed with the project's key, and the app refuses any update that isn't.

This is the last version you need to download by hand. From here on, updates install from inside the app.

Install

  1. Download ur.transcribe-0.1.2-macos-arm64.dmg below.
  2. Open it and drag ur.transcribe into Applications, replacing the old version.
  3. Open it from Applications.

Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon.
